admission.justification: The packet removes what the strip shows, not what the routes return; a change that trimmed the projection to the strip's new needs would break every other consumer of the same answer. The review verified the module is byte-identical to the base apart from the untouched field set.

applicability: Every caller of the routes that serve a role execution: the launcher and any other reader of the same answer.
conditions: The last-reply summary, report record and capability fields remain in the execution projection.
The launcher's own use of the fields may change; the returned data does not.
exclusions: This rule changes neither the projection's schema nor who may call it.
Showing or hiding the data in the strip is rule 1's concern; the data itself stays.
statement: Existing execution result summary and report fields remain available to backend consumers.
